name: Warrior
description: A stalwart defender who shields allies from harm with heavy armor and an unbreakable will.
lore: Forged in the fighting pits of Ironhold, Warriors are the backbone of any dungeon party. Their ability to absorb punishment and redirect enemy aggression keeps squishier allies alive.

abilities.name: Slash
abilities.description: A reliable sword strike that deals physical damage.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.description: Raises shield, increasing Physical DEF by 50% and Magic DEF by 20% for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.description: Forces all enemies to attack the Warrior for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Crushing Blow
abilities.description: A devastating strike that deals 2x physical damage and reduces enemy Physical DEF by 30% for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Rallying Cry
abilities.description: Inspires all allies, increasing Physical ATK by 20% for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Iron Skin
abilities.description: Passive: Permanently gains 10% Physical Resistance and 10% Poison Resistance.

abilities.name: Last Stand
abilities.description: Ultimate: Become invulnerable for 2 turns, heal 30% HP, and gain 50% Physical ATK for 3 turns.

synergies: Cleric: Sustained frontline — Warrior tanks while Cleric keeps HP topped off
Rogue: Warrior holds aggro while Rogue deals massive backstab damage
Mage: Taunt protects the fragile Mage during long cast times
weaknesses: Low damage output without Crushing Blow
Low INT makes magic damage very effective against them
Slow — often acts last in turn order
MP-starved if Taunting and Shield Walling frequently
hire_description: A scarred veteran leans against the guild wall, arms crossed over dented plate armor. "Need someone to stand between you and death? That's my specialty."
